questions: Do you live in a house or an apartment?
What do you like most about the place where you live?
Is there anything you would like to change about your home?
Do you think you will live in the same place in five years' time?
Are you usually busy in the mornings?
What is the first thing you do after you wake up?
Did you have the same morning routine when you were a child?
Do you think mornings are a good time to study?
Does it rain a lot where you live?
What do you usually do on a rainy day?
Do you prefer rainy weather or sunny weather? Why?

part2.cue: Describe a time when you learned a new skill that was useful to you.
points: when and where you learned it
part2.final: and explain why this skill was useful to you.
followups: Do you think you will learn other skills like this in the future?

questions: What kinds of skills do young people in your country most want to learn nowadays?
Is it better to learn a practical skill from a teacher or from online videos?
How has technology changed the way people learn new things?
Why do some adults decide to go back to education later in life?
Should employers pay for their staff to learn new skills?
Do you think older people find it harder to learn new things than younger people? Why?
